description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including registration and login, using FastAPI framework. It handles user creation, credential verification, and token issuance.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Response model for returning access tokens and user info.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Model representing user info that can be publicly exposed.

methods.name: TokenResponse register_user(payload: UserCreate, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration: creates a new user, hashes password, and returns an access token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: UserLogin, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user login: verifies credentials and returns a JWT token.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def login_user(payload: UserLogin, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def register_user(payload: UserCreate, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db)) -> TokenRespo/
